Faults: shutil.copyfile raising OSError('disk'); os.rename raising OSError('interrupted'); Cache.verify raising OSError('interrupted') (after the rename); the first sync_directory in publish raising OSError('interrupted') (after pending is made); and, in the interrupted cases, Cache.remove raising OSError('killed') so the cleanup cannot run. Each step keeps its result (ok value, or exception class and message), the journal (the live state, or OWNERS.json on disk), and the cache tree (kind and relative path).
